title: State of Maharashtra v. Vishwanath Tukaram Umale

content.caseIdentity: State of Maharashtra v. Vishwanath Tukaram Umale, (1979) 4 SCC 23
content.holding: Reaffirmed that theft is an offence against possession, not ownership; an owner who takes his own property out of the lawful possession of a bailee or person holding a lien commits theft.
